name: x3x3
title: Rate matrix constructed from rate matrices on each triplet position

args.name: a
args.description: The triplet alphabet, including a codon alphabet

description:
Construct a substitution model on a triplet alphabet, including a codon alphabet, from separate nucleotide models for the three positions. Each instantaneous substitution changes one nucleotide.

Stationary inputs produce stationary models. For stationary non-reversible inputs, equilibrium frequencies are recalculated from the constructed rates. For non-equilibrium inputs, root frequencies are the products of the nucleotide root frequencies, normalized over the allowed triplets or codons.
